INCLUSION: ordinary nights are open to the public - the county FAQ says 'travelers passing through may park nightly at the RV hookups on the Fairgrounds', so not event-only. The county's pages name no event closures; the fairgrounds calendar has events most weekends (e.g. 'KSCB Home Show' Nov 7-8), and no camper report mentions being turned away.
HOOKUPS: electric amperage cleared (county silent; RV Life reviews don't give amps either); water and sewer at the site confirmed by the FAQ's hook-up classes.
